Vendored TypeScript sources of a corner smoothing library, version 1.1.0, by Tien Pham (MIT), downloaded from the npm registry. Package integrity: sha512-3aa6bOurrsybsuYo1TMRuasBpXgVjgnmOUtZ40il6e1dJF2lhTRq89z7oy1uzKDspbH3630rLZD2UvJqXDiktA== . The full license is retained in every source file and LICENSE. The geometry code is unchanged; only names and comments differ from the release. This is an independent approximation with no guarantee of matching any other tool's geometry. Forma validates and bounds inputs before use.
